subject: Onramp checklist and timeline — API keys, org setup & VPC peering
messages:
From: Dana Li <dana.li@corehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Moore <evan.moore@corehealth.com>
Date: 2025-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onramp checklist and timeline — API keys, org setup & VPC peering

Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the latency numbers and the cost projection. We want to lock in a short POC to validate inference throughput with our sample clinical workloads. To keep things moving on our side, here are the pieces we need from Redwood (and what we'll deliver):

- API keys and example request templates (for our infra team to smoke tests)
- Redwood-managed org or a dedicated workspace (so we can separate logs from prod)
- IP allowlist template + CIDR to add to our firewall
- VPC peering instructions and expected peer CIDR ranges
- A mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and an estimated close date

Can you confirm the suggested timeline and send the IP template and a draft MAP? Our target: start environment provisioning by 5/26 and run workload validation the week of 6/2. If that's tight for you, call that out and propose alternatives.

Attached: our standard intake sheet (we filled basic details) — let us know if you need service accounts or NAT gateway details.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Li
Technical Program Manager, CoreHealth
Attachments: corehealth-intake.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@corehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-20T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp checklist and timeline — API keys, org setup & VPC peering

Dana — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) API keys & templates: we can issue scoped API keys for the POC (read/generate only). Connor will generate a set and post them securely to the DocuSign-protected share by EOD 5/22. We'll include curl + python examples that match your payloads.

2) Org/workspace: we can provision a dedicated org under Redwood Private for the POC or create a dedicated project in our hosted account. For the timeline you proposed, a hosted project is faster (same access controls, separated logs). If you require VPC-only access, we should do the org + peering route — allow 3 business days for peering setup.

3) IP allowlist: attached is our redwood-ip-allowlist-template.csv (see VPC vs public endpoints section). We need the public egress IPs you'll call from or the VPC peer CIDR if you route privately.

4) VPC peering: see the attached vpc-peering-instructions.pdf describing the steps, required AWS IAM perms, and recommended CIDR ranges. We'll need one-hour maintenance window for route propagation, but no downtime for inference endpoints.

5) MAP: drafted timeframe below — please review and flag blockers.

Proposed MAP summary (high level):
- 5/20: Kickoff & intake (today)
- 5/22: Redwood provides API keys + allowlist template + MAP draft (Connor)
- 5/26-5/28: Network provisioning & VPC peering (if chosen) + workspace provisioning
- 6/02-6/06: Workload validation (latency/throughput tests)
- 6/09: Wrap-up, success criteria review, and commercial close discussion

If you confirm hosted project instead of peering, we can shave 2-3 days off the network steps.

I'll loop Connor on the keys and Marissa for account-level approvals & contract check.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-ip-allowlist-template.csv, vpc-peering-instructions.pdf, map-draft-corehealth.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Dana Li <dana.li@corehealth.com>
Date: 2025-05-21T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp checklist and timeline — API keys, org setup & VPC peering

Hannah / Connor — quick internal note to approve hosted-project path unless Dana explicitly requests VPC-peered private deployment. Hosted project notes:
- No platform fee change, POC usage billed at standard eval rates; we'll track token usage separately in the MAP.
- For audit controls, enable 30d retention on logs and provide a service-account key with read-only metrics access to CoreHealth (if they want).
- Ask Legal to expedite a one-page SOW that covers agreed acceptance criteria (throughput target + allowed regressions).

Connor: please prepare the API key artifacts and a short readme on how to swap to peered mode if they decide later.

Marissa
VP, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Evan Moore <evan.moore@corehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Dana Li <dana.li@corehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onramp checklist and timeline — API keys, org setup & VPC peering

Hannah / Marissa — thanks for the fast responses. CoreHealth prefers VPC peering for this POC to keep traffic inside our VPC for compliance reasons. We can commit network engineering time the week of 5/26.

Next actions from our side:
- I'll send the VPC peering request and the peer CIDR by 5/23 EOD.
- We'll provide the NAT and route table screenshots once peer request is accepted.
- Dana to confirm the acceptance criteria by 5/23 (throughput target and max 95th percentile latency).

If you can confirm the maintenance window and a contact for the peering handoff (Connor?), we can lock 5/26 for provisioning.

Evan
Network Ops Lead, CoreHealth
Attachments referenced: none
